evidence: TiCl4 was vaporized from liquid source container at room temperature and TEA was vaporized from heated hot source container. They were both introduced into ALD reactor chamber by N2 carrier gas. The pulse sequence was as follows; TiCl4 pulse, N2 purge, TEA pulse and N2 purge. In order to systematically investigate the TiAlC characteristics, the deposition temperature was changed from 250◦C to 375◦C in the cold wall reactor.
